comment: Structure of the gallery section: nav tabs, medium pages, section pages, browse pages, the artwork filter facets and the hub page's photographs. Edited by hand; consumed by build.mjs to render gallery*.html. Bilingual site copy lives here as literal UTF-8 because this is localized content, not code. heroSlides, aboutPanels, a browse page's cover and a medium page's optional cover each point at one photograph in content/artworks.json by artworkId plus imageIndex; the build refuses an in-situ view in any of those slots because the hub crops a photograph to fit its slot and an in-situ shot must keep the framing it was taken with. A medium page with no cover falls back to the first photograph of its first work; a medium page with no works renders mediumEmptyCover instead of promising an image. A browsePages entry names one facet key and renders the whole catalogue as one section per value of that facet, so it cuts across medium where the filter bar cannot; values no work carries are skipped rather than rendered empty. newArrivalsPage lists real artwork ids newest-first (the order is editorial, not derived, so an undated work can still be featured). portfolioPage carries only intro copy; the build groups the whole catalogue by mediumPages order. artistsPage plus the artists array profile the people behind the work; each artist has a cover photograph (same in-situ rule) and bioEn/bioZh paragraph arrays, and the single-artist catalogue renders in full beneath the bio.

newArrivalsPage.metaDescription: The latest paintings to join Kay's Gallery, newest first.
newArrivalsPage.introEn: The most recent paintings to join the gallery, newest first. Each one is painted from life and shown here as soon as it is finished.
newArrivalsPage.introZh: 最近加入画廊的画作，新作在前。每一幅都写生而成，画完即在此展出。

portfolioPage.metaDescription: The full body of Kay's work, grouped by medium.
portfolioPage.introEn: The full body of work, grouped by medium. From painted fruit and flowers to birds, animals and fish, this is everything in the gallery in one place.
portfolioPage.introZh: 全部作品，按媒介分组。从画中的果实与花卉，到飞禽、走兽与游鱼，画廊的所有作品都汇聚于此。

artistsPage.introEn: The hands behind the work. Kay's Gallery shows the paintings and drawings of a single artist.
artistsPage.introZh: 作品背后的创作者。Kay's 画廊展出同一位艺术家的绘画与素描。

bioEn: Kay paints from life, working close to the subject until the shape of a lemon, a fig or a fish feels solid on the panel.

The work moves across subjects without leaving the still, watchful mood that ties it together. Fruit from the branch and the vine sits beside birds and animals caught in a single pose, fish turning through green and blue water, a bloom seen up close and a cabin far off in the snow.
Most of the work is in paint, with the catalogue reaching into drawing as well. New paintings join the gallery as soon as they are finished.
bioZh: Kay 写生作画，贴近对象反复观察，直到柠檬、无花果或游鱼的形体在画板上站得住为止。
作品在不同题材间游走，却始终保持那份安静而专注的气质，将一切串连起来。枝头与藤蔓的果实，与定格于一个姿态的飞禽走兽、在绿水蓝水间转身的游鱼、近处盛放的花、以及远方雪中的木屋并置一处。
大部分作品为绘画，画册也延伸至素描。新作画完即加入画廊。

browsePages.introZh: 画廊中的全部作品，按描绘的题材分组，跨越所有创作媒介。

browsePages.introZh: 画廊中的全部作品，按主导色彩分组。一件作品若有多种主色，会出现在每一组中。
